selected_evidence.requirement: Kernel actually driven out of memory and oom-killer invoked

selected_evidence.summary: dmesg confirms pid 1721 (hog) killed; same command shows systemctl is-active inventory-api=active and curl /healthz succeeding immediately after the kill

selected_evidence.summary: inventory-api MainPID still 1602 (never restarted), /inventory data correct, no hog process remains, swap restored to 2GiB/0-used baseline
